how_to_address_and_route.cbn_escalation_addressee: Director, Consumer Protection Department (CPD), Central Bank of Nigeria

complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_1: Write to your bank first; demand reversal/refund, request investigation report, and obtain acknowledgment/reference.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_2: If not resolved, escalate to CBN CPD with full evidence and the bank’s reference/timeline.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_3: For fraud/scams/identity theft, report to EFCC/NPF and copy CBN CPD.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_4: If deposit protection/failed bank liquidation matters arise, contact NDIC and attach account evidence.
